ratification.scope: One confirm-or-correct of model, signs, lattice, boundary, observables, and grid.
ratification.rule: Ratification is satisfied. Any physics-parameter or measurement-protocol change requires a versioned amendment and renewed ratification.

lattice.vertices: all elementary up and down triangles

analytic_qa_bound.word_bound: For the subspace U of sites touched by a nonempty fixed-s word, ||T_U||_infinity <= q < 1, using the last local factor touching each row.
analytic_qa_bound.strict_weight: det(I+T)>0 for every configuration; untouched sites contribute identity blocks.
analytic_qa_bound.qa_consequence: Any computed zero or negative weight is an implementation or numerical-stability failure, not an allowed boundary case.

randomness.engine: NumPy PCG64DXSM; exact package version frozen in run snapshot
randomness.hot_start_rule: Ordered CT times are analytically integrated into beta^m/m!; at initial_order=round(beta*N), draw each resolved word label independently from q(a)=lambda_a/G0 (uniform among 2*N triangles, equal A/B probability, and uniform S3 at the frozen equal couplings).
randomness.seed_policy: Seeds are immutable; diagnose a failed chain rather than replace it.

momenta.deduplication: Deduplicate coincident momentum indices at small L while retaining all protocol labels in provenance.
momenta.G1_L3_note: L=3 has no integer M point; use Gamma, qmin, and the two K points.

gates.name: algebra_unit_tests
checks: A/B entries and all S3 embeddings
strict word bound and inverse/condition bounds
rank-3 determinant ratios equal full rebuild
isolated N=3 triangle is local-algebra QA only, not an ED thermodynamics fixture
gates.pass: All deterministic residuals pass; negative_sign_count and zero_weight_count are zero.
gates.fail: Any persistent algebra, update, zero-weight, or determinant-sign mismatch stops the workflow.

gates.name: N_le_9_exact_diagonalization
fixtures: periodic L=2 N=4 fixture with directed-triangle multiplicity recorded
gates.pass: Each estimate agrees with ED within max(5*MCSE, 1e-10), convergence passes, and no zero or negative weight occurs.
gates.fail: A reproducible ED discrepancy, nonconvergence at the frozen cap, or nonpositive weight stops the workflow.

gates.name: pilot_resource_and_tau_int
outputs: frozen warmup and production sweep counts
fast-update versus rebuild accuracy and speed
gates.pass: Convergence, sign, acceptance, update, residual, and resource gates pass.
gates.fail: Unbounded tau_int, hot/cold disagreement, unstable updates, no scalable path, or unbounded resources blocks full runs.

gates.name: full_grid
gates.cells: All five L values crossed with all four beta values
gates.chains: Four fixed-seed chains per cell: two cold and two hot
gates.run_length_rule: Freeze warmup at at least 50*max_tau_int and production for ESS targets. Extend all four chains equally in preregistered batches.
gates.pass: All 20 cells pass correctness, positivity, residual, R-hat, and ESS thresholds.
gates.fail: A hard-stop condition marks the cell failed and blocks an unconditional large-lattice claim.

gates.name: independent_audit
checks: recompute selected weights and observables from durable snapshots
verify seed, initialization, and chain provenance
verify no failed chain was replaced or excluded
rebuild timing and memory tables from raw logs
gates.pass: Independent reconstruction matches recorded outputs and provenance.
gates.fail: Any provenance mismatch, selective exclusion, nonpositive weight, or unreproducible statistic blocks completion.

diagnostic: determinant sign and zero/negative weight counts
fast-vs-rebuild relative error and inverse residual
R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS, and tau_int

thresholds.scalability_claim_rule: Withhold scalability if speedup is not above 2 by N=144, update time scales worse than N^2.7, or memory worse than N^2.5 after excluding N=16.

pilot.status: proposed/TBD; inspect live Slurm state before submission

full.status: proposed/TBD from accepted pilot throughput, memory, and tau_int

resources.submission_rule: Assume no partition. Check sinfo, squeue, and node State/CfgTRES/AllocTRES before each submission; use durable stages and afterok dependencies.

stop_fail_conditions: No compute before setup ratification and no gate skipping.
Any computed zero or negative weight is a hard failure, never a discarded sample.
Persistent fast-vs-rebuild mismatch or residual above threshold stops the run.
Acceptance outside the full hard range after pilot-frozen tuning fails or makes the cell inconclusive.
R-hat or ESS failure after equal extension to the pilot-frozen cap makes the cell inconclusive.
OOM, timeout, missing durable checkpoint, or missing completion sentinel is failure.
Do not start L greater than 12 before a stable, faster rank-3 update passes the pilot.
Never change seeds, discard chains, or retune physics after inspecting full-grid observables.
State the mu=0 low-temperature vacuum and unresolved itinerant finite-density problem in every interpretation.

interpretation_limits.mu_zero_low_temperature: The positive-semidefinite construction has a vacuum ground state at mu=0, so low-temperature density can be trivial.
interpretation_limits.finite_density: No nontrivial itinerant finite-density sign-free extension is preregistered here.
interpretation_limits.claim_scope: A pass supports this fixed mu=0 correctness and scaling benchmark only.
